content:
**Ordnance Express** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

This perk reduces the weight of grenades, mines, and explosive ammo.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Explosives weigh 90% less. | 00391F0B | 
| ★ | 1 | Explosives weigh 45% less. | 00391F0A |
